note: Hand-written inputs for scripts/progress-data.mjs. Releases: summary and figures the release reports lack. Timeline: curated entries in CEST; covers names generated events (release:<world>@<v>, ipc:<v>, world:<v>) an entry already describes.

lumen-reach@0.4.0.summary: First release: Sun Court, Array Hall, Rime Vault and Signal Rise, 24 mounts, routes and alternate stairs

lumen-reach@0.5.0.summary: Visual polish in every home; about 60 frames/s per home at Medium on an Intel iGPU at 4K

lumen-reach@0.6.0.summary: Rime Vault frost and density pass

lumen-reach@0.6.1.summary: Moves to world format 0.5: authored visibility regions for every home

lumen-reach@0.7.0.summary: Closed sky dome and mountain basin; flight passes over the perimeter; 56-view any-angle sweep and full route traversal

lumen-reach@0.7.1.summary: Fixes from the first live walk: sky seam, a capped stair, the night sky

lumen-reach@0.8.0.summary: First release on world format 0.7: KTX2 textures, meshopt geometry and lightmap mips; same look and frame time

lumen-reach@0.8.1.summary: Closes a Rime Vault ceiling slot that showed sky; the build now fails on sky leaks through enclosure roofs and walls

lumen-reach@0.9.0.summary: Visibility derived at build time (184 regions); per-area playable volumes with a 60 m fly ceiling; backstops only where a walker can reach; canonical areas contract

lumen-reach@0.9.1.summary: Fixes from live testing: the four primary walls are true 16:9 frames, signs clear the roofs, rails on the rooftop walkway, bridge and raised landings, a terrain shading fix

switchyard@0.1.1.summary: The public test world: vault concourse, timber docks and station rings

timeline.title: Schemas v0 and the foundation RFCs
timeline.text: IPC 0.1 and world format 0.1 with a validator; RFC-0001–0008 and this site.

timeline.title: Core M0: a safe place
timeline.text: Exact-version Hyprland plugin, hypruned daemon, original room, free flight, emergency exit, nested test harness.

timeline.title: Core M1: materials and navigation
timeline.text: IPC 0.2 and world 0.2: camera, waypoints, travel and autodrive; PBR materials and UV1 lightmaps.

timeline.title: First real session
timeline.text: Core, the Quickshell shell and the Switchyard test world over authenticated IPC 0.3.

timeline.title: Workspace homes
timeline.text: IPC 0.4 and world 0.3: areas, typed mounts, placement volumes, HDR bloom and sky lighting.

timeline.title: Hands-on interaction
timeline.text: IPC 0.5: tools, carrying and custom window placement.

timeline.title: Keymap v2
timeline.text: IPC 0.6 and the input schema: three bindings per action, live-reloaded and editable in Settings.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.4.0 and Switchyard 0.1.1 released
timeline.text: The first official world packages.

timeline.title: Starter kits and installers
timeline.text: Nix flake, NixOS and Home Manager modules, kits and an Arch installer in the meta repository.

timeline.title: Dynamic render scale
timeline.text: The change behind 60 FPS at 4K on the iGPU.

timeline.title: Graphics presets and hold timing
timeline.text: IPC 0.7 and 0.8: Low/Medium/High/Ultra and auto, with GPU timings for the shell.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.5.0
timeline.text: Visual polish pass.

timeline.title: RFC-0009 proposed
timeline.text: Optional supervised GPU offload.

timeline.title: HUD telemetry
timeline.text: IPC 0.9: opt-in HUD streams and concept cycling.

timeline.title: Performance page and offload phase 1
timeline.text: IPC 0.10: live Performance controls. Offload phase 1 merged, off by default. Lumen Reach 0.6.0 released (23:13).

timeline.title: Climbing contracts
timeline.text: IPC 0.11 and world 0.4: climbable volumes and three climbing styles.

timeline.title: Climbing merged; recording and free cursor
timeline.text: IPC 0.12: deterministic input and camera recording and replay; Super+Tab or Back for a real cursor.

timeline.title: Ink and visibility
timeline.text: IPC 0.13 and world 0.5: authored outline style, visibility regions and an authoring photo camera.

timeline.title: Ink quality tiers
timeline.text: IPC 0.14: fast and smooth outlines with persistent overrides.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.6.1
timeline.text: The first release on world format 0.5.

timeline.title: Tool slots and the pocket
timeline.text: IPC 0.15: shared Primary/Secondary/Alternate/Cycle bindings and the Placement tool's pocket queue.

timeline.title: Playable bounds and recovery
timeline.text: World 0.6 fly bounds. The shell survives invalid frames and renews its credentials without dropping the session.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.0
timeline.text: Closed sky dome, any-angle checks, full route traversal.

timeline.title: World-derived workspace homes
timeline.text: The world room is workspace 20 and each area's home is 20 + its slot.

timeline.title: Render on demand
timeline.text: Static scenes stop rendering, and compositor GPU load drops from 42% to 1%.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.1
timeline.text: Fixes from the first live walk of 0.7.0.

timeline.title: World format 0.7
timeline.text: Compressed and optimised scene assets: KTX2, meshopt and quantised meshes.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.2
timeline.text: A walkable, clear roof route.

timeline.title: Optional capture watermark
timeline.text: Saved captures can carry the Hyprune lockup; off by default and never drawn live.

timeline.title: Selectable upscaler
timeline.text: IPC 0.16: FSR 1 or bilinear from the shell's Graphics settings.

timeline.title: Parallel shader compile
timeline.text: The longest upload job drops from 51 to 31 ms.

timeline.title: Derived visibility prototype
timeline.text: Visibility regions generated from the navmesh and scene.

timeline.title: World shader specialisation
timeline.text: World shading is 21% faster on Intel Low.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.8.0
timeline.text: The first release on world format 0.7: 41% smaller, 45% less GPU memory, same frame time.

timeline.title: Autodrive climbs stairs and ramps
timeline.text: Autodrive walks routes with the same walker as the keyboard instead of a straight line that stopped at every stair foot.

timeline.title: Idle GPU from 2% to 0.07%
timeline.text: Workspace walls recompose only when their windows change.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.8.1
timeline.text: A Rime Vault ceiling slot no longer shows sky; a new check catches sky leaks through enclosures.

timeline.title: Walls follow native stacking order
timeline.text: Raising a window in Hyprland raises it on its world wall too.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.9.0
timeline.text: Derived visibility, per-area playable volumes with a 60 m ceiling, walking-only backstops and canonical areas.

timeline.title: Capture notes
timeline.text: IPC 0.17: after U, the shell asks why and saves the note with the capture.

timeline.title: Hands-on fixes
timeline.text: Static world geometry, carrying a window from behind, wallpaper on empty walls, snapping into tool mounts.

timeline.title: Frame pacing and wall clarity
timeline.text: Ticks follow presented frames, targets pace evenly, walls render at native resolution.

timeline.title: Robust render-pass tracking
timeline.text: Recovers when the compositor never signals the end of a pass.

timeline.title: Offload on NVIDIA and device selection
timeline.text: Cross-GPU offload works with NVIDIA compositors; IPC 0.18 picks the GPU and scales the power cap to it.

timeline.title: Grab stall fixed
timeline.text: Starting a carry from behind: 239 ms to 0.16 ms.

timeline.title: Player settings and the reticle
timeline.text: IPC 0.19: field of view, walk and run speed, reach limits, view bob, and a contextual reticle in six styles.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.9.1
timeline.text: Fixes from live testing: 16:9 primary walls, signs clear of roofs, rooftop rails, a shading fix.
